name: foundations
title: Standing on these shoulders
html:
Standing on these shoulders

  • Roy T. Fielding the dissertation (2000)
  • Roy T. Fielding “REST APIs must be hypertext-driven” (2008)
  • Mike Kelly HAL
  • Mike Amundsen HAL-FORMS
  • J. Badeau HAL Schema Forms, the base of HEART’s media type
  • J. Badeau HyperBench, a hypermedia-driven workbench
  • Kin Lane API Evangelist
  • Adib Saikali “REST is for Agents”, Spring I/O 2026
  • Rohit Bhardwaj (Salesforce) “From REST to Reasoning Agents”
  • Michael Carducci “Hypermedia APIs and the Future of AI Agentic Systems”
  • Kelsey Hightower “ZTA: Zero Token Architecture”, WeAreDevelopers 2026: infer once, run everywhere
  • W3C Autonomous Agents on the Web Community Group
  • Ciortea et al. “A Decade in Hindsight”, AAMAS 2019: one of numerous papers
say: Links only. Fielding; Mike Kelly's HAL; Mike Amundsen's HAL-FORMS; J. Badeau's HAL Schema Forms, the base of HEART's media type, and HyperBench; Kin Lane; Adib Saikali; Rohit Bhardwaj and Michael Carducci on hypermedia and agents; Kelsey Hightower's Zero Token Architecture, an inspiration for this talk; the W3C Autonomous Agents on the Web Community Group; and one of numerous research papers, Ciortea et al. at AAMAS 2019.
